sql: SELECT o.strategy, count(DISTINCT o.kalshi_order_id) AS filled_orders, count(DISTINCT o.market_ticker) AS markets FROM live_orders o JOIN fills f ON f.kalshi_order_id = o.kalshi_order_id WHERE o.strategy LIKE '%mmsell10' AND o.action = 'buy' AND o.side = 'no' AND o.created_at >= '2026-10-30 00:00+00' GROUP BY 1
